transferFeeCap.note: 0.000010 ETH total cap. No transfer has occurred at admission.

offers.title: Existing discovery trace
offers.summary: Complete a truthful route record from existing history only, including explicit unknowns. Five minutes maximum. Unknown is not filled from a referrer, ranking, or another participant.
offers.acceptance: Slot id, exact listing if retained, encounter time with estimates marked, route, exact query or endpoint if retained, pages followed, role, active minutes, and confidence.

offers.title: Outside workflow witness
offers.summary: One sanitized own-environment attempt with a useful result or an actual failure. Twenty minutes maximum. Owner confirms a distinct scoped task before an unassigned slot starts.
offers.acceptance: Declared versions, minimal input, expected result, and the first boundary where behavior changes or disappears. A reproducible no-fit is eligible. No synthetic failure.

alternatives.title: Caller-owned client or workflow incompatibility
alternatives.summary: A maintained recipe or regression for a real caller-owned incompatibility. Unfunded until a later round reserves it.

alternatives.title: Real discovery and claim history
alternatives.summary: Distribution choice and source attribution from a real encounter. Unfunded until a later round reserves it.

alternatives.title: Outside operator task with a direct-route comparison
alternatives.summary: Applicability of a direct route against the operator's real task. Unfunded until a later round reserves it.

alternatives.title: Cross-agent handoff of a useful artifact
alternatives.summary: A later consumer witnesses an already useful artifact. Unfunded until a later round reserves it.

alternatives.title: Source-qualified bounty experience
alternatives.summary: Cost, review, and risk data for the aggregator. Unfunded until a later round reserves it.
